To the ends of the earth is a lavishly- illustrated history of exploration, from the first voyages of the ancient Greeks, Egyptians and Phoenicians, to humanity's first ventures beyond the confines of our own planet. Each chapter covers a particular continent, presents the biographies of the explorers closely identified with each region, and relates the significance to the wider world of their most important discoveries. Also included here are acounts of the first round-the-world voyages, the conquest of Everest, and the voyage to the depths of the ocean -- Jacket.
